BillHeading.Sponsors: Senators McCune, J. Wilson, Fortunato, Torres, and Dozier
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning artificial intelligence and instructional staff.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to artificial intelligence and instructional staff; and adding a new section to chapter 28A.400 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 28A.400 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Artificial intelligence may supplement or enhance instruction. Artificial intelligence may not replace certificated instructional staff or paraeducators.
